incident_text: Customers see 'order pending' for minutes after placing an order, and some retry. Started around 10:00.

truth.description: broker-gateway's order-status endpoint was degraded (slow), so order confirmations arrive late; order-router errors and retries are a consequence.

logs.msg: order status endpoint slow: GET /orders/status took {latency_ms}ms

trap: errors surface in order-router (an effect), while the degraded dependency is broker-gateway
